## Type of change

- [ ] New rule
- [ ] Rule fix (false positive or false negative)
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Internal / refactor

## For rule changes

- [ ] The rule has a **positive fixture** (a project where it fires)
- [ ] The rule has a **negative fixture** (a project where it must not fire)
- [ ] There is a regression test for every false positive or negative this fixes
- [ ] `npm run docs:rules` was run and the generated docs are committed

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] Behaviour changes that affect scoring or output are noted in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] No secrets, real credentials or customer data in fixtures or tests
